intro.title: Component Composition
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple user profile interface by combining multiple Angular components. You'll learn the core concept of component composition, which involves nesting smaller, reusable components inside a larger parent component. The main technologies used are Angular components, TypeScript, and HTML templates. This approach helps you create modular and maintainable applications by breaking down complex UIs into smaller, manageable pieces.
intro.usecase: Component composition is fundamental to building maintainable Angular applications like e-commerce sites, where you compose product cards, shopping carts, and checkout forms from reusable components. In dashboards, you assemble data panels, charts, and filters into cohesive interfaces without duplicating code. This pattern enables teams to build complex UIs like social media feeds or admin panels by combining smaller, tested components rather than creating monolithic, hard-to-maintain code.
